review: Tool comparisons need a tiny library-independent reference fixture, judge caching lineage, and an explicit offline versus provider-dependent execution boundary.
build: Define a small canonical dataset and deterministic pass/fail cases, then run one selected library on a subset. Record its metric version, required fields, judge, and dependencies. Construct an immutable evaluation corpus and compare paired retrieval runs; intentionally inject an unsupported answer, revoked citation and judge-disagreement case.
verify: Export raw per-case outcomes and missing/error states. Reproduce one result without a dashboard and show why two similarly named metrics need not be numerically comparable. Run `python3 -B labs/eval_platform_contract.py`; report gold source recall and confusion counts. Actual hosted Langfuse/LangSmith/Phoenix/etc. adapters are separate acceptance.
